inputs.goal: build a 30/60/90 plan for a staff data engineer joining the platform team

30_days: Meet core team members and understand team dynamics
Get familiar with the project infrastructure and codebase
Setup development environment (tools, VPN, access credentials)
Participate in initial onboarding sessions and training programs
Start contributing to small tasks or bug fixes
60_days: Deep dive into major systems & data pipelines
Identify and address gaps in current knowledge/data processes
Collaborate with team members on larger projects/features
Begin exploring opportunities for process improvements
Attend relevant meetings and contribute ideas/suggestions
90_days: Propose and implement optimized solutions to identified issues
Take ownership of key components or processes within the team
Mentor junior engineers and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
Fully integrate into team workflows & contribute strategically
Participate in long-term planning & roadmap discussions
